references.text: Describes an angel rolling away the stone from Jesus' tomb and sitting on it, which also happens in Matthew 28:2
The women wonder who will roll away the stone for them, but find it already removed when they arrive, paralleling the angel's actions in Matthew 28:2
They find the stone rolled away from the tomb, just as in Matthew 28:2, even though the angel is not directly mentioned here
The women see that the stone has been rolled away and a young man in white clothes inside the tomb, which can be compared to the angel's appearance in Matthew 28:2
